takeaway: Saliva is the gastrointestinal fluid richest in potassium; 1 to 1.5 litres are secreted each day by an active process.

question.text: Which of the following gastrointestinal fluids is richest in potassium?
question.say: Which of the following gastrointestinal fluids is richest in potassium?

lines.text: The bananas splash in the salivary fountain.
lines.say: (laugh) The potassium bananas are splashing in the salivary fountain!

lines.text: Saliva is the fluid richest in potassium.
lines.say: Saliva is the gastrointestinal fluid that is richest in potassium.

lines.text: The salivary gland pours out 1 to 1.5 litres a day.
lines.say: The salivary glands secrete about one to one and a half litres each day.
Salivary secretion is an active process.

lines.text: First a plasma-like fluid forms, then the ducts modify it.
lines.say: A primary secretion forms first, like an ultrafiltrate of plasma, and is then modified as it flows along the duct system.

lines.text: Remember: saliva is the potassium-rich fluid.
lines.say: Remember: saliva is the potassium-rich fluid.
